newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH STATS BURO POLL H1 '97 TRD DEFICIT CZK 85BLN.
newsitem.headline: CZECH STATS BURO POLL H1 '97 TRD DEFICIT CZK 85BLN.

text.p: The Czech Republic's trade deficit for the first half of 1997 should rise to 85 billion crowns from 69 billion in the first half of 1996, a survey of importers and exporters by the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) showed on Wednesday.
The actual deficit for the first four months of 1997 was 53.65 billion crowns.
The poll was conducted before the Czech crown came under severe pressure from speculators forcing the central bank to abondon its policy of fixing the crown against a mark/dollar basket.

The curency fell by almost 10 percent on Tuesday, the day after the central bank move, to around 19.5 against the mark. The survey, which was sent to 180 companies, also anticipates import growth of 10 percent year-on-year in the first half of the year and export growth of seven percent.
The survey respondents accounted for 23 percent of total import volume in the first quarter of the year and 38 percent of export volume, the CSU said.
